name: MN-05
label: Safe D

key_factors: Omar's incumbency and large fundraising edge
Markets price Omar at ~96% to win
model.rationale: The D+32 district, Omar's incumbency, and her roughly eight-to-one fundraising advantage over John Nagel all point to a decisive Democratic win, and prediction markets price her around 96%. With no polling or expert ratings suggesting otherwise, the fundamentals-based margin of about 30 points stands.
model.watch: A surprise scandal or primary fallout shifting Omar's general-election standing is the main thing that could tighten this race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview: Minneapolis-based MN-05 is one of the most Democratic districts in the country, with a partisan lean of D+32. Incumbent Ilhan Omar is seeking another term and holds a commanding financial position, having raised about $5.8 million with $1.3 million on hand. Republican John Nagel has raised about $750,000 but ends with under $50,000 in cash, and no outside groups are active in the race. An independent candidate, DeVelle Jackson, is also on the ballot but has shown little fundraising. Prediction markets give Omar roughly a 96 percent chance of winning. With no public polling and no expert ratings, the race rests on fundamentals, which uniformly point to a comfortable Omar victory in this deep-blue seat.
